title: Señal 336
style: Reggaeton pop with dembow-locked percussion, Spanish guitar riffs, and brass swells; intro opens sparse with spoken male delivery and ocean ambience, verses stay tight and conversational, pre-choruses stack duet harmonies and filtered tension, choruses hit wide with gang vocal repeats and horn punches. Close-mic lead vocal, lush male/female doubles on the hook, ad-lib throws and a brief guitar break before the final lift. Bright, punchy mix with warm low end and cinematic width., big band, noise, soft, spoken word, psychedelic rock, stride, soul, reggaeton, strong, gentle, tone, steady
lyrics:
[Intro]
In the quiet before the storm, I chose peace...
No quiero pelear, me retiro voluntario...
Family first, truth in the chest
Three three six, burning here

[Verse 1]
Mud sticks on the surface
It never reaches the core
They threw stories, I gave evidence
I walked right out the door
Michelle by my side
Kaos and Tuco at our feet
House in my name
Lafise on the street
I build while they talk
I create while they hate
Signal three three six
Locked in, never late

[Pre-Chorus]
They want war, I give truth
They want noise, I give proof
Three three six in the blood
In the beat, in the root

[Chorus]
Mud sticks, pero verdad prevalece
Truth rises, family stands
The signal never sleeps
Three three six
Three three six
We don’t break, we don’t bend
Mud sticks, pero verdad prevalece
Verdad en el corazón
Familia unida, seguimos de pie

[Verse 2]
They came with fire
I answered with calm
Recorded the truth
With a steady hand
No abuse, no games
Just facts on the line
While the clock kept moving
One hundred sixteen lies
I protect what’s mine
I protect what we built
Ocean behind me
Future in front, no guilt

[Pre-Chorus]
They fabricate, I document
They project, I stay present
Three three six
Pure and evident

[Chorus]
Mud sticks, pero verdad prevalece
Truth rises, family stands
The signal never sleeps
Three three six
Three three six
We don’t break, we don’t bend
Mud sticks, pero verdad prevalece
La verdad siempre gana al final
We keep building while they fall

[Bridge]
In the middle of the noise
I found silence inside
Three three six guiding
Every step, every stride
Not sick, not broken
Feliz, alive
De-escalated every time
Chose to thrive
Spanish blood in the guitar
Ocean in the soul
This is the signal
That makes the whole system whole

[Final Chorus]
Mud sticks, pero verdad prevalece
Truth rises, family stands
The signal never sleeps
Three three six
Three three six
We don’t break, we don’t bend
Mud sticks, pero verdad prevalece
This is how we win
Verdad... verdad... prevalece...
Three three six... locked in... forever...

[Outro]
No más mentiras... solo verdad
Familia primero... señal three three six...
Mud sticks... pero verdad prevalece.
